title: Klein samplers - switch every shipped Klein graph and Flow from euler to lcm
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-748 - Head Swap on Klein follow-ups (created 2026-09-13; itself a member of MPI-560). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-748/plan.md.

Switch every shipped Klein graph from the euler sampler to lcm. DECIDED by Fabio 2026-09-13 on bench evidence; this card is the execution plus the per-op verification.

EVIDENCE (Fabio, 2026-09-13):
- BFS Klein head swap workflow (Alissonerdx/BFS-Best-Face-Swap) ships lcm; euler in the same graph was 'terrible' by comparison.
- Klein text-to-image: 3 prompts, each at one fixed seed, lcm vs euler = 6 generations. lcm removes the EXTRA LIMBS euler produces, and quality is slightly better.

WHY WE WERE ON EULER: inherited, never measured. The official Comfy-Org templates for distilled Klein 4B and 9B edit use euler / Flux2Scheduler 4 steps / cfg 1, exactly our config (docs/models/klein/README.md, Shipped config). No sampler A/B was ever run on our Klein graphs; the MPI-600 9B bench is euler-only. The BFS graph differs from ours ONLY in the sampler, so the head swap A/B isolated it.

SCOPE (scanned 2026-09-13 across comfy_workflows/**; no sampler is shared with a non-Klein model):
- Klein image graph, one template generating both sizes via comfy_workflows/scripts/workflow_generation/generate_klein.py -> klein_t2i.json (4B) and klein_9b_t2i.json (9B). KSamplerSelect nodes 24, 112, 171. The template exists TWICE and BOTH must change (Fabio): comfy_workflows/raw/klein_t2i_template.json (the UI-format authoring copy) and comfy_workflows/scripts/workflow_generation/klein_t2i_template.json (API format). Edit both, then REGENERATE; never hand-edit the generated files.
- LanPaint_KSampler node 652 (the removal path, docs/models/klein/removal.md) also says euler, but it is LanPaint's inner sampler, not a KSamplerSelect. Do NOT flip it blind: A/B removal separately and keep euler there if lcm hurts.
- Flows on Klein 9B, node 188 KSamplerSelect in raw + runtime each: flow_draw_it_in, flow_object_stamp, flow_scribble.
- Docs naming euler as the shipped config: docs/models/klein/README.md (Chain + Shipped config), docs/models/klein/removal.md.
- The Klein head swap Flow (MPI-744) is born on lcm, so it is not in this card.

TRAP: in the Klein graph, Flux2Scheduler.steps and CFGGuider.cfg have input links, so their widget values are dead (docs/models/klein/README.md, WIDGET-VS-LINK). sampler_name is a plain widget, so the change is one value per node, but do not touch steps or cfg while in there.

VERIFY: same-seed lcm vs euler per op that owns a sampler (t2i, edit/i2i, depth, removal) on both sizes, and one run per Flow; the generated diff shows ONLY sampler_name changing; tests/inject-params-titles.test.cjs, scripts/verify-workflow.mjs and validate-injection-rules.mjs green.
